annotation.title_clean: We Robot 2025: Connecting Global Robotics and AI Governance Experts in Canada
annotation.title_en: We Robot 2025: Connecting Global Robotics and AI Governance Experts in Canada
annotation.venue: Canadian Journal of Law and Technology (23 C.J.L.T.)
annotation.summary_en: Editorial introducing a special issue of the Canadian Journal of Law and Technology drawn from the We Robot 2025 conference at Windsor. It describes the interdisciplinary conference and summarizes papers on robotic agriculture and labour, delivery robot perception, interoperable AI regulation, generated personal data, contracts, and facial recognition.
key_provisions_or_claims: We Robot 2025 was held at University of Windsor, its first in-person Canadian edition.
The conference is an interdisciplinary hub for robotics and AI law and policy.
Special issue papers cover robotic agriculture and labour control, delivery robot expressiveness and public perception.
Other papers address interoperable AI regulation, GDPR and generated personal data, and facial recognition privacy.
